sheets.name: physical
sheets.prompt:
The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for crisp, simple, flat front-on retro handheld RPG impact sprites. Replace its content with the new sheet specified below. Create exactly THREE columns by FOUR rows: 12 distinct sprite cells, equal square cells, three consecutive frames per effect. True transparent background. Portrait 3:4 canvas. No text, numbers, labels, grid lines, characters, weapons, scenery, ground plane or shadows. Keep generous transparent gutters and center anchors. Columns are onset, full hit, dispersing aftermath; same center and scale system per row, with natural growth then disappearance.

Art direction: flat orthogonal FRONT-ON screen-plane VFX applied over a target's picture, as in early 16-bit GBA-style monster battle effects. Crisp stepped pixel clusters, limited flat palettes, clear shapes at small size, no smooth gradients, soft bloom, blur, glossy 3D shading, side-view swooshes, boomerangs, elliptical ground rings or perspective tails. An impact is a graphic mark facing the viewer. Each row must have a distinct silhouette and sparse cleanup frame. Do not repeat a whole hit in frame three.
ALL FOUR ROWS are PHYSICAL: ONLY white, pearl white and neutral cool STEEL GRAYS. Absolutely no yellow, gold, orange, saturated blue or other elemental color.
ROW 1 SINGLE SLASH: exactly ONE clean tapered diagonal cut from upper-left to lower-right. Frame1 one short thin cut, frame2 ONE long decisive white gash with a narrow steel-gray edge, frame3 that ONE gash broken into aligned fading fragments. Never three cuts or a curved swoosh.
ROW 2 MULTI-HIT SLASH: three parallel diagonal cuts, white/steel; frame1 three small starts, frame2 three long distinct sharp gashes, frame3 three broken segmented traces.
ROW 3 SMASH: an asymmetric old-comic IMPACT BOOM graphic without lettering. A lopsided jagged burst with very UNEVEN outward spikes: some long thin vectors, some short broad blunt wedges, irregular spacing, off-center impact core. Think comic punch impact/splat silhouette. Definitely NOT a regular star, NOT a symmetric starburst, NOT a circular badge. Frame1 compact irregular crumpled flash; frame2 broad forceful uneven jagged boom, white center and steel-gray edge, only a few displaced angular debris chips; frame3 broken irregular rim pieces with open center. Maintain the asymmetry and striking white/steel physical palette.
ROW 4 THRUST: a small face-on puncture impact, a compact narrow diamond-like hole with four unequal short needle cracks pointing out. Frame1 pinprick, frame2 pointed white puncture with steel-gray border and tiny sharp shards, frame3 small separated shards. No visible spear and no side-view traveling projectile.
